control.units: rad for arm hinges; m for stock gripper sliders

cameras.name: robot_head
cameras.role: robot visual observation; fixed virtual eye above the shoulders
cameras.mode: fixed to torso; no target tracking, zoom or cropping
cameras.approximation: OpenArm has no head. Eye mount is a declared adapter design assumption, informed by but not copied from Reachy reference coordinates.

coordinates.ros_optical: Conversion uses diag(1,-1,-1): +Z forward, +X right, +Y down

references.title: Reachy 2 official head and torso camera specifications
references.observation: Official localisation drawing shows the eye 62 mm above its neck reference and that reference 115 mm above the upper-body origin; forward offset is 35.31 mm. These are Reachy coordinates, not OpenArm shoulder coordinates.

references.title: Unitree official head-perspective camera example
references.observation: Actual image inspected: hands and tabletop dominate the working area; forearms and a chest edge remain visible at the bottom. Visible body parts alone do not make a view third-person.

references.title: Unitree official XR camera hardware and mounting
references.observation: Distinguishes head-mounted cameras from wrist cameras. The optional wide-angle stereo hardware does not prescribe a universal vertical FOV or tilt.

references.title: MuJoCo camera and plane definitions
references.observation: Fixed cameras look along local -Z, image up is +Y, fovy is vertical angle. A plane has infinite collision extent; its first two sizes control only the rendered rectangle. Zero values render an infinite plane.

references.title: ROS REP 103 camera optical frame
references.observation: Optical convention is +Z forward, +X right, +Y down. Converting from MuJoCo requires changing Y/Z signs; no image mirroring is used.

provenance.model: Official OpenArm v1 bimanual MJCF already in repository
provenance.reference: Same unmodified arm inertias, joint limits, arm actuator gains and force caps as existing bimanual_robot.py; only declared fixed base placement, camera/sites and selected end tool differ.

category_note: operation_end includes every collision part of the active S end-effector; idle_hand is the complete unused arm and tool; robot_other is the rest. Legacy v2.1 did not qualify by working face. Current S-tool v2.2 additionally identifies true blue pulling or orange pushing surfaces from solved contact geometry and wrench; the operation_end group must not be narrowed to hide back-side contacts.
